title: [Feature][Model] Use CANN operators for GLM-5.3-Flash pooled indexing
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Connects BF16 GLM-5.3-Flash pooled indexing to CANN KeyPool/PoolKeyIndexer, including DSA-CP. Reuses layer/draft metadata and removes redundant SFA input preparation. Depends on #18295.

PD/MTP fixes keep per-group block tables stable across FULL graph replay, preserve circular-tail cache addressing, cover graph capture buckets, and reject incompatible Mooncake circular-cache layouts.

Includes the empty-query guard from #18771: eager/piecewise DSA-CP shards with no actual queries still update the replicated caches, then return `-1` indices without calling PoolKeyIndexer. FULL capture retains selection so replay can process live queries.

Refs #15665

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

BF16 KPool uses CANN operators for ordinary TP and DSA-CP.

### How was this patch tested?

245 CPU/mock regression tests passed for this head in the official v0.30.0rc2 A5 image, without NPU devices. Tests cover metadata reuse, FULL graph padding, MTP circular-cache addressing, Mooncake layout rejection and empty DSA-CP query shards. The original implementation fails four new empty-shard cases; the fix passes them, including shared strided output buffers and NONE/PIECEWISE/FULL runtime modes.

Historical joint full-model performance with #16730 + #18295 on A5/CANN 9.2.0, TP8/EP/MTP3, BF16 indexer and FP8 SFA cache, using `vllm bench serve` (vLLM `0.30.0+empty`), 256 output tokens, seed 1024 and temperature 0. Reference: frozen main [`05fa3be5`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/commit/05fa3be5f50306a151d4863735d3d84ce63dc0a2). Each case/arm ran once without active profiling; all requests succeeded with exact lengths and no KV preemption.

| Input / concurrency / requests | Output tokens/s (main → combined) | Throughput Δ | Mean TTFT Δ | Mean TPOT Δ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 4096 / C8 / 64 | 340.033 → 443.616 | +30.46% | −7.46% | −25.58% |
| 4096 / C64 / 128 | 676.309 → 737.094 | +8.99% | −6.74% | −4.29% |
| 4096 / C90 / 180 | 712.100 → 724.663 | +1.76% | +0.22% | −2.39% |
| 65536 / C8 / 16 | 40.798 → 49.467 | +21.25% | −17.65% | −15.10% |
| 1048576 / C4 / 8 | 0.873 → 1.998 | +128.80% | −55.44% | −57.64% |

Output throughput includes prefill and queueing. The candidate also contains newer upstream changes, so these results do not isolate CANN or Triton gains. At 1M, mean TTFT was 647.24 → 288.41 s and mean TPOT 1897.44 → 803.83 ms; client C4 reached peak running 3 on both arms. Both arms extended the native total-token limit by 256 to allow output (`max_model_len`/`max_position_embeddings=1048832`, unchanged RoPE). This is not 1M semantic accuracy validation; the separate C1 rank-0 profile is excluded from these measurements.

The historical combined main CANN/Triton implementation also completed two full GSM8K runs per arm (1319 questions, C64, temperature 0, seed 1024, max_tokens 4096): raw scores were 1267/1272 for the candidate and 1264/1269 for frozen main 05fa, with no request errors or truncated outputs. Each paired difference was +0.227 percentage points; repeat variation was 0.379 points, so this does not establish an accuracy improvement. The candidate also includes existing upstream changes; this is not an isolated CANN effect. Current-head full-model PD/DSA-CP accuracy and prefill regression validation remain pending.


- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/c4df37dfcc7f72ca41cd43801a468526ecf99a2b
